# Bokmål glossary: Norwegian words the nb spell check accepts although the
# dictionary and Norsk Ordbank reject them. Language-neutral tokens (names,
# identifiers, formats) live in glossary.shared.txt instead. One word per
# line; '#' starts a comment; matching is case-insensitive.
#
# The dictionary is full-form (inflections are separate entries), so an
# accepted term's other forms need their own lines — add them as the check
# reports them.
#
# Glossary or suppression? One rule: a CORRECT word the checker doesn't
# know belongs here; a WRONG spelling that cannot change belongs in
# suppressions.mjs, scoped. A misspelling "fixed" by a glossary entry stays
# wrong in the product, so prefer fixing the text. Reviewing this file in a
# PR IS the native-speaker check: every line claims the word is correct
# bokmål used deliberately — remove a line to re-flag it everywhere. An
# entry that no longer rescues any flagged word is reported as stale by the
# check itself.

# Loanword inflections used deliberately in the UI. Solid inflection is
# correct for lowercase loanwords (repoet, releasen). INITIALISMS inflect
# with a hyphen (API-er, URL-en, ID-ene) — the corpus norm — and never need
# an entry here: the acronym half is an all-caps token the check skips.
# A solid APIer/URLer is a writing error and must stay a finding.
dashboardet
monitorering
popups
releasen
repoet
repositorier
repositoriet
repositorium
subdomener
webserveren

# Halves of legitimately hyphenated compounds — the tokenizer splits
# them at the hyphen, so the halves need their own entries.
aktiverings             # aktiverings-e-post
bekreftelses            # bekreftelses-e-post
påloggings              # påloggings- og registreringssidene
tofaktor                # tofaktor-autentisering
trinnsautentisering     # 2-trinnsautentisering

# Kept pending a native ruling: used deliberately in the product, but
# unusual enough to deserve a human yes/no. Remove a line to re-flag.
autoriseringsforespørselen  # Gitea translation; the sibling key says 'autorisasjonsforespørselen' — harmonize?
avstandsjustert             # Gitea's rendering of 'monospace' (avstandsjustert skrift)
beskrivelsesløse            # ad-hoc -løse derivation in the Gitea UI (emneløse, ikonløse, beskrivelsesløse)
bolsk                       # calque of 'boolean' used as a data-type label in the expression editor
delstreng                   # calque of 'substring' in a Gitea validation message
fravelg                     # calque of 'deselect' in the Gitea UI
føderert                    # 'føderert avatar-oppslag' (federated) in the Gitea UI
gjennomsynsforespørsel      # Gitea's rendering of 'review request'
gjentagende                 # variant of 'gjentakende' in the Designer news feed
godkjenningsoverskrift      # Gitea's rendering of 'authorization header'
lesmeg                      # calque of 'README' in the Gitea UI
produksjonssette            # verbified 'sette i produksjon' in Designer
tvangsdyttet                # Gitea's rendering of 'force-pushed'
